regime: sequential_color_processing; per-path server_ms sums one SealPIR generate_reply per color and is not an all-colors-hot-cache single wall time

stage_definitions.offline_key_setup_ms: sum of per-color PIRClient construction and Galois key generation
stage_definitions.database_setup_ms: sum of per-color deterministic 32B database generation, SealPIR plaintext packing, and NTT preprocess
stage_definitions.query_color_bytes: per-color bytes from saving the same generated PirQuery ciphertexts with compr_mode_type::none
stage_definitions.server_generate_reply_color_ms: per-color PIRServer::generate_reply wall time in color order
stage_definitions.server_expansion_ms: sum inside generate_reply expanding encrypted selection vectors
stage_definitions.server_query_ntt_ms: sum inside generate_reply transforming expanded query ciphertexts to NTT
stage_definitions.server_database_ntt_ms: sum inside generate_reply transforming current plaintext database/intermediate plaintexts to NTT when needed
stage_definitions.server_inverse_ntt_ms: sum inside generate_reply transform_from_ntt on intermediate ciphertexts
stage_definitions.server_recursive_decomposition_modswitch: sum inside generate_reply recursive mod-switch and ciphertext decomposition to plaintexts
stage_definitions.server_modswitch_color_ms: per-color time to apply the upstream response mod-switch step; included in server_ms
stage_definitions.server_color_ms: per-color generate_reply plus server_modswitch time; sums to server_ms
stage_definitions.response_color_bytes: per-color bytes after server mod-switch and Ciphertext::save(compr_mode_type::none)

comparison_regime.scope: TreePIR backend tuning only for the same generated leaf schedule and configured height
comparison_regime.note: Spiral and PIRANA are separately investigated and not measured by this runner.
